notes: Original volumetric measurement of H2 uptake on AX-21 activated carbon and a catalytically grown MWNT, 233-318 K, up to 11 MPa. Table 1 gives uptake at 6 MPa, 233-298 K. The MWNT BET area is stated as 137 m2/g (N2, 77 K); AX-21 area is stated for the sample used ('about 3000 m2/g'). The paper cites an earlier evaluation of the AX-21 heat of adsorption [20] but does not state that its uptake values were published before, so duplicate_data does not apply. Not retracted (record.json is_retracted false; no retraction notice in text). Primary research article in English.
